name: Behringer TD-3
source: Written 2026-11-07 for the binding map. A device the hub clocks and plays; this profile is only what it could send back. [UNVERIFIED] Not captured from a unit: the TD-3's knobs, switches and step buttons send no MIDI, and its keys and sequencer are assumed to put notes on its MIDI channel (default 1) over USB.

groups.comment: [UNVERIFIED] the 13 keys C..C (pattern C = note 36) and the sequencer's notes; the whole note space is claimed so a transposed pattern still decodes

layout.reason: [UNVERIFIED] free: bind a key to any target in the Bindings window; nothing is bound until you do
